file-transfer.title: File Transfer
file-transfer.desc: Send files directly between phones, connected by number or QR

text.2台のスマホで、片方が「番号を出す」、もう片方が「番号で参加」を押してください。: On two phones, press “Show a number” on one and “Join with a number” on the other.
text.相手のカメラでQRコードを読むか、番号を入れてもらってください。: Have the other phone scan the QR code or enter the number.
text.相手の画面に出ている6桁の番号: The 6-digit number on the other screen
text.相手の画面の確認番号と同じなら許可してください。違う時は断ってください。: Allow if it matches the check number on the other screen. If not, decline.
text.送ったファイル・受け取ったファイルがここに並びます: Sent and received files appear here
text.ファイルは端末どうしの暗号化された通信(WebRTC)で直接届きます。つなぐ相手: Files travel directly between the devices over encrypted WebRTC. The public PeerJS server is used only to find each other, and the PeerJS relay server only when a direct link fails; neither can read the contents. If both screens show the same check number, no one is in between. When connecting, each device’s IP address is shared with the other and with the meeting server. Text-heavy files are compressed automatically. If the link drops, it reconnects for up to 60 seconds and continues; if that fails, connect again and press “Resend” to continue (closing either page starts over). Received files are held in memory, so on phones aim for up to a few hundred MB to 1 GB per file. Keep the screen open while transferring.
